seoTitle: How to Make a Calendar with Canva (Step-by-Step)
metaDescription: Design a print-ready calendar in Canva using the Calendar Maker app to generate accurate monthly grids, then customize and export as a PDF.
intro: Designing a custom calendar in Canva doesn't require manually plotting out every date grid — the built-in Calendar Maker app handles the layout for you. This guide covers picking the right template size, generating monthly grids, adding photos and reminders, and exporting a print-ready file.

steps.heading: Choose your calendar size
steps.body: Search and select a template size suited for a wall or desk calendar, then set your canvas margins.

steps.heading: Launch the Calendar Maker app
steps.body: Open the Canva Apps section and find the Calendar Maker tool to generate accurate monthly grids automatically.

steps.heading: Select your target year
steps.body: Choose the year you want and let the app generate the corresponding monthly layouts.

steps.heading: Customize dates and cells
steps.body: Adjust date font styles, block cell containers, and layout dimensions in bulk to match your design.

steps.heading: Add photos and reminders
steps.body: Drop personal photos or background elements into page frames, then add holidays, milestones, or custom text reminders.

steps.heading: Export as a print-ready PDF
steps.body: Preview each page, then configure high-quality print settings and export your finished multi-page calendar.

faq.question: Does Canva generate the date grids automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, the Calendar Maker app builds accurate monthly grids for your selected year, so you don't have to lay out dates manually.

faq.question: Can I add my own photos to each month?
faq.answer: Yes, you can drop personal photos or vector graphics into page frames for each monthly layout.

faq.question: What format should I export for printing?
faq.answer: Exporting as a high-resolution, print-ready PDF is the recommended format for physical calendar printing.

faq.question: Can I add holidays or personal reminders to the calendar?
faq.answer: Yes, custom text items for holidays, milestones, and reminders can be added directly to each date cell.
